summary: Insurance Product Information Document (IPID) for easyPROTECT PRO - Property insurance, which covers events likely to damage insured property, provided that such events and property are designated in the Special Conditions and only in the context of the professional activity indicated in the Special Conditions. The document lists eight eligible sectors of activity, six categories of insurable property (building, equipment, goods, harvesting, animals, self-propelled land vehicles) and twelve guarantees offered, from fire, water damage, theft and climate risks to decontamination of soil, interruption of activity and transport. Three restrictions on cover carry figures: an annual terrorism intervention limit of EUR 10,000,000, a maximum compensation limit of EUR 100,000 for property damage, and a 25% cap on portable office automation and computer equipment. Both the covered list and the exclusion list are printed as "Non-exhaustive list".

definitions.definition: Building: main part of the building with annexes and outbuildings (whether contiguous or not), including fences; real estate improvements and improvements to the building rented by the insured person; solar panels and satellite dishes.

Equipment: objects used for the insured activity, belonging both to the insured person and to third parties, such as installations (in the warehouse, workshop or office), professional equipment* (mechanical or electrical machine tools, except self-propelled machinery), or office automation and computer equipment**
Goods: supplies, raw materials, commodities, finished products, packaging, waste, etc.
Harvesting: crops and land products, as well as fodder and fertilizers
Animals: domestic animals, farmed animals or animals intended for sale
Self-propelled land vehicles: any vehicle, including self-propelled machinery

gaps: Pictogram marks: the ticks, crosses and exclamation marks of this IPID are placed bitmap images (page.get_images() / image blocks of get_text("dict")), neither text nor vector drawings. Counted and assigned by coordinate: page 1 = 35 images, namely 26 green ticks (xref 19, 120x133 px), 6 red crosses (120x121 px) and 3 orange exclamation marks (xref 21, 40x148 px); page 2 = 3 green ticks (xref 19). The counts close exactly against the printed items: 26 ticks = 8 "Sectors of activity" + 6 "Insurable property" + 12 "Guarantees offered"; 6 crosses = the 6 items of "What is not insured ?"; 3 exclamation marks = the 3 items of "Are there any restrictions on cover ?"; and on page 2 the 3 ticks = the 3 territorial areas (Moving, Travel, Transport). Polarity was settled on a 4x render (green tick = insured, red cross = not insured, orange "!" = restriction). These marks are not text and therefore cannot appear in key_quotes.

Layout note that matters for attribution: the "What is insured ?" box is not confined to the left column. It runs down the left column (x0 29.8, 22 ticks) and CONTINUES at the top of the right column (x0 308.2, y 256.0-316.0, 4 more ticks: "** Breakage of professional equipment", "Decontamination of soil and insured property", "Interruption of activity/operations", "Transport"), before "What is not insured ?" starts lower in the same right column at y 383.3. Those four items were verified on a render to sit inside the green-tick box, above the red "What is not insured ?" banner. The flat text emits them in that same order, so no covered item was read as an exclusion.

Reading-order check (two-column page 1): the flat text emits the left column before the right column and follows the box wrap correctly, so there is NO column reversal. The only deviation is vertical: the two full-width blocks printed at the top of page 1 (the "Disclaimer" at y 130.7 and "What type of insurance is it ?" at y 180.6) are emitted LAST in the flat text, after all three boxes. Attachment was rebuilt from block coordinates throughout.

PRINTED DEFECT, kept and not repaired: the footnote asterisks are crossed. Under "Insurable property - Equipment" the document prints "professional equipment*" (one asterisk) and "office automation and computer equipment**" (two asterisks), while under "Guarantees offered" it prints "* Breakage of office automation and computer equipment" (one asterisk) and "** Breakage of professional equipment" (two asterisks). So the single asterisk marks "professional equipment" in one list and the office-automation guarantee in the other, and the double asterisk does the reverse. Confirmed on a 7x render, so it is printed and not a text-layer artefact. Both readings are recorded verbatim; the guarantee names keep their printed asterisks and nothing was swapped.

The restrictions box "Are there any restrictions on cover ?" holds three quantified limits (EUR 10,000,000 annual terrorism intervention limit for Fire, EUR 100,000 maximum compensation for Property damage, 25% cap on portable office automation and computer equipment). The schema has no separate restrictions array, so they are recorded in exclusions with the box named in each description, AND the same figures are attached to the corresponding coverages (limits / sub_limits). This is a deliberate double entry, not two different facts.

"Insurable property" (Building, Equipment, Goods, Harvesting, Animals, Self-propelled land vehicles) is printed inside the "What is insured ?" box with green ticks, but describes what property may be insured rather than a guarantee. The six items are recorded in definitions, not in coverages, and this choice is declared here so nothing looks lost.

"Sectors of activity" (Sect. 1 to Sect. 8) is likewise printed inside the "What is insured ?" box with green ticks. The eight sectors are recorded as eight separate special_conditions entries and repeated verbatim in target_audience_note; they were not merged.

The guarantee named "Water damage" is described in this document solely as "material damage resulting from blockage or breakage of gutters, guttering or storm water drains". That wording is recorded exactly as printed and was NOT completed from any other language version of this IPID, even though the description is narrower than the guarantee name suggests.

Rubric/content mismatch, kept and not repaired: a contract-duration rule is printed inside "Where am I covered ?". The "Moving" territorial item ends with "In the event of a transfer of the policyholder's domicile or registered office abroad, the insurance shall no longer be tacitly renewed and shall cease to have effect on the day of its next annual expiry date." It is kept in the territorial special_conditions where it is printed and additionally recorded in duration_and_cancellation.special_rights.

Rubric/content mismatch, kept and not repaired: the "Moving" item also carries a reporting obligation ("subject to the policyholder reporting the transfer to the Company within three months of the transfer"), printed under "Where am I covered ?" rather than under "What are my obligations ?". It is recorded in obligations with its three-month timing and left in place in the territorial block.

No deductible/franchise is mentioned anywhere in the document; deductibles is null. No waiting period is mentioned; waiting_periods is empty. No prescription period is mentioned; prescription_period is null.

No insured sums are given: every amount is referred out to the Special Conditions, which are not part of this file. The only figures printed are EUR 10,000,000, EUR 100,000, 25%, 10%, 600 km, "15 years old", "eight days", "three months", "30 days", "one month" and "60 days", all copied verbatim. The euro glyph occurs zero times in the text layer, but the document spells the currency "EUR" before the figures on the render as well, so no currency mark was lost.

No edition date and no document reference are printed on either page (there is no footer); edition_date and reference are null. The PDF file metadata carries CreationDate D:20181008141529+02'00' and the InDesign file name "IPID_LALUX_easyPROTECT PRO - Entreprise - Assurance de choses_EN.indd" - file metadata, not printed content, and therefore not used as an edition date. Note that the file name says "Entreprise" while the document itself never uses that word; the document was preferred over the file name.

Risk carrier: the document names only the brand "LALUX Assurances" ("LALUX Assurances - Product : easyPROTECT PRO") and refers to "the Company" throughout. It never names a licensed insurance undertaking, so no carrier was derived from the brand. insurer_slug and insurer_name are copied unchanged from the task metadata.

The document states that cover applies "only in the context of the professional activity indicated in the Special Conditions" and lists eight eligible sectors that span both self-employed professionals (liberal professions, crafts) and businesses (hotels, restaurants, agriculture), so it does not select between "independants" and "entreprises". The printed wording is kept in target_audience_note; nothing was deduced from the product type or from the file name.

All three boxes close with the printed note "Non-exhaustive list". The extraction is complete with respect to the document, but the document declares its own lists incomplete; the full guarantee-by-guarantee exclusions are in the general and/or special conditions, which are not part of this file.

is_optional is null for all twelve guarantees: the document lists them under "Guarantees offered" with a green tick each but never says which are included by default and which must be taken out. Three of them state a dependency instead ("Self-propelled land vehicles: if fire, theft or climate risks are insured", "Interruption of activity/operations: if the interruption is caused by a loss insured with fire, water damage or climate risks cover", and the Travel territorial extension "when the 'Fire', 'Water damage' and 'Climate risk' insurance is taken out"), which is recorded in conditions.

Text-layer artefacts: narrow spaces U+2009 before question marks and colons in headings ("What is insured ?", "Product :"), curly apostrophes and curly double quotes (U+2019, U+201C/U+201D) inside sentences, and a leading tab left by each bitmap bullet. key_quotes are exact slices of this text layer (cut from the PDF, never retyped) and carry these characters; description fields were lightly cleaned (line breaks to spaces).

product_family: the document prints two designations - the banner "easyPROTECT PRO – Property insurance" and the product line "LALUX Assurances - Product : easyPROTECT PRO". product_family takes the fuller banner form rather than the bare range name "easyPROTECT PRO", so that other products sold under the same range are not merged into this family. No edition date and no distribution variant appear in either designation, so variant is null.
